key_insight: MS-ECG-FM expands ECG foundation-model training beyond ECG reports by contrastively aligning ECGs with multiple clinical note types, enabling richer and more universal cardiac representations.
clinical_relevance: By learning from complementary sources like echocardiography, radiology, and discharge notes, the model may improve detection performance across a wider range of ECG-relevant conditions, including reduced-lead setups.
method: Contrastively align ECG signals with multiple clinical note types
Use multi-source supervision from ECG, echocardiography, radiology, and discharge reports
Learn shared representations that capture complementary diagnostic information
evidence_signal: In extended ECG detection benchmarks, the model is reported to outperform existing methods across the full range of detectable conditions, including reduced-lead configurations.
watch_item: Performance gains depend on access to high-quality paired clinical notes, and real-world deployment may be limited by missing, inconsistent, or institution-specific documentation.
paper_title: MS-ECG-FM: Towards a More Universal Electrocardiogram Foundation Model for Health Monitoring using Multi-source Contrastive Learning
